summary: Regression smoke test after cosmetic frontend fixes (RoadmapDialog stable keys, Control.loadDevice console.error, SystemStatusLight console.debug). All 4 main pages load without errors: Dashboard (KPIs, energy flow, header status line 'Update · Uhr · 4/4 online'), Steuerung (sliders prefilled, 'Werte vom Gerät laden' updates 'Geräte-Werte geladen: HH:MM:SS'), Verlauf (charts, Energiebilanz), Diagnose (Geräte-Details, StatusBanner, Alarm-Historie, Selbst-Test). System status light shows level=ok. Roadmap dialog opens on footer version click and renders all 3 sections (Erledigt/Geplant/Ideen) — stable keys did not break rendering.

issues: Console warning: Missing Description/aria-describedby on Radix DialogContent (a11y). Non-blocking.
Recharts warns about container width/height(-1) during initial mount — chart still renders correctly after layout settles.

critical_code_review_comments: RoadmapDialog uses item text as React key which is unique for current content, but if two items ever share the same text it will break — acceptable for a static list.
Consider adding a DialogDescription to RoadmapDialog to silence the Radix a11y warning.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 14 covered the cosmetic-fix regression: Dashboard, Steuerung, Verlauf, Diagnose, Roadmap dialog, and system status light all verified. Only pre-existing benign console warnings (Radix DialogContent aria-describedby, Recharts initial container size).
